items.example: I regret not saying sorry earlier.
items.simple: You feel sad because of something you did or did not do.

items.example: I wish I had studied harder at school.
items.simple: You say this when you are sad about something that already happened.
items.note: Geçmişe dair pişmanlık: wish + past perfect.

items.example: I should have called her back yesterday.
items.simple: You did not do the right thing, and now you know it.

items.example: In hindsight, I should have said no.
items.simple: Understanding something clearly only after it has already happened.

items.example: In hindsight, taking that job was a mistake.
items.exampleTr: Şimdi düşününce o işi kabul etmek hataydı.
items.simple: You look back and see what was wrong or right.

items.example: What would you do if you won the lottery?
items.simple: You ask someone to imagine something that is not real, and say what they would do.

items.example: If I were you, I'd talk to him.
items.simple: You say what you think is best for another person.

items.example: It's high time we found a new flat.
items.exampleTr: Artık yeni bir daire bulmamızın zamanı geldi de geçti.
items.simple: You should have done it before. Now you must do it quickly.
items.note: High time'dan sonra past simple gelir.

items.example: Don't blame me, it wasn't my idea.
items.simple: You say a bad thing happened because of someone.

items.example: I forgot his birthday. I could kick myself!
items.exampleTr: Doğum gününü unuttum. Kendime çok kızıyorum!
items.simple: You are very angry at yourself for a silly mistake.

items.example: I know I messed up, but it's too late now.
items.exampleTr: Batırdığımı biliyorum ama artık çok geç.
items.simple: The time to do it has passed. You cannot change it.

items.en: No use crying over spilt milk.
items.example: Forget it. There's no use crying over spilt milk.
items.exampleTr: Boşver. Olan oldu, üzülmenin anlamı yok.
items.simple: Do not be sad about a thing that is already done.

items.example: I'm having second thoughts about moving abroad.
items.exampleTr: Yurt dışına taşınma konusunda tereddüt yaşıyorum.
items.simple: You said yes, but now you are not so sure.

items.example: I look back on that summer with a smile.
items.simple: You think about things that happened long ago.

items.example: Come with us, or you'll miss out on the fun!
items.simple: You do not get a good thing because you were not there.

items.example: As luck would have it, he was home.
items.simple: By chance, something happened. It can be good or bad.
items.note: İyi ya da kötü tesadüfler için.

items.example: Thank goodness you're safe!
items.simple: You feel happy because a bad thing did not happen.

items.example: I lost my keys again. Lesson learned.
items.simple: You made a mistake and now you will do better next time.

items.example: I learned the hard way never to trust him.
items.exampleTr: Ona asla güvenmemem gerektiğini acı tecrübeyle öğrendim.
items.simple: You learn something only after something bad happens to you.

items.example: Supposing we got lost, what would we do?
items.simple: You ask someone to imagine something that is not true right now.

items.example: It's just a hypothetical question, don't worry.
items.exampleTr: Sadece varsayımsal bir soru, merak etme.
items.simple: Not real. You only imagine it.

items.example: Just imagine if we'd missed the flight.
items.simple: You ask someone to see a pretend thing in their mind.

items.example: I'd rather you didn't tell her yet.
items.exampleTr: Henüz ona söylemesen daha iyi olur.
items.simple: You say that you do not want the person to do it.
